title: Polynomial-Time Computability of the Greatest Common Divisor
statement: For a bit string $z$, decode its two components, taking either component to be empty if decoding fails, and interpret each as a natural number in least-significant-bit-first binary. The function returning the binary representation of the greatest common divisor of those two natural numbers is computable in polynomial time by a finite Turing machine.
